title: Finance (No. 2) Act, 2024 (Act No. 15 of 2024)
publishingOrganisation: Ministry of Law and Justice & Income Tax Department, Government of India
factsSupported: Amendment to Section 111A (STCG to 20%), Section 112A (LTCG to 12.5%, exemption to ₹1.25 Lakh), Section 112 (LTCG on unlisted/real estate/gold to 12.5%), holding period harmonisation, and grandfathering amendment for real estate indexation.

title: Finance Act, 2023 - Introduction of Section 50AA for Specified Mutual Funds
publishingOrganisation: Income Tax Department, Government of India
factsSupported: Statutory definition of Specified Mutual Funds (holding <= 35% in domestic equity) and elimination of indexation/LTCG benefits, taxing all capital gains at slab rate as deemed STCG.
applicablePeriod: Investments acquired on or after 1 April 2023

title: Master Directions - Non-Banking Financial Company – Peer to Peer Lending Platform (Reserve Bank) Directions, 2017 (Updated August 2024)
factsSupported: RBI regulations governing NBFC-P2P platforms: aggregate lending cap of ₹50 Lakh across all platforms, maximum ₹50,000 to a single borrower, prohibition of credit enhancement or assured return guarantees, fund-flow escrow mechanics through bank-operated trustees, and mandatory risk disclosures.
applicablePeriod: Continuous regulation with August 2024 compliance amendments

title: Sovereign Gold Bond Scheme Master Directions & Operational FAQs
publishingOrganisation: Reserve Bank of India & Ministry of Finance
factsSupported: Tenure of 8 years with early exit options from 5th year; 2.50% p.a. simple interest payable semi-annually; capital gains tax exemption on redemption under Section 47(viic) of Income Tax Act.
applicablePeriod: All SGB tranches issued under GoI notifications

title: Securities and Exchange Board of India (Real Estate Investment Trusts) Regulations, 2014 (Last Amended September 2024)
publishingOrganisation: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
factsSupported: Mandate that minimum 80% of REIT assets must be completed and rent-generating; minimum 90% of Net Distributable Cash Flows (NDCF) must be distributed to unit-holders semi-annually; trading lot size of 1 unit on stock exchanges; introduction of Small & Medium REITs (SM REIT) framework for asset sizes ₹50 Cr to ₹500 Cr.

title: Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation Act, 1961 & Amendment Act 2021
publishingOrganisation: Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (Subsidiary of RBI)
factsSupported: DICGC insures principal and interest up to ₹5,00,000 per depositor per bank across all branches for commercial, rural, and small finance banks in the same capacity and right; mandatory payout within 90 days of moratorium.

title: Securities and Exchange Board of India (Alternative Investment Funds) Regulations, 2012 (Consolidated)
publishingOrganisation: Securities and Exchange Board of India
factsSupported: Classification into Category I, II and III AIFs; minimum investment ticket of ₹1 Crore per investor (₹25 Lakhs for employees/directors of AIF); unlisted securities investment restrictions and mandatory dematerialisation of units.

title: Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS) for Resident Individuals - Master Direction
factsSupported: Permitted remittance limit of up to USD 250,000 per financial year for permissible current and capital account transactions including overseas equity investments; collection of TCS under Section 206C(1G) at 20% on remittances above ₹7 Lakhs.

title: PFRDA (Exits and Withdrawals under the National Pension System) Regulations
publishingOrganisation: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
factsSupported: Mandatory 60% lump sum exit at age 60 (100% tax-exempt) and minimum 40% mandatory annuity purchase; maximum equity exposure cap of 75% under active choice up to age 50 tapering down; fund management charges capped at ultra-low 0.09% p.a.

title: National Savings Schemes (PPF, NSC, SCSS, SSY) Interest Rate Notifications
publishingOrganisation: Ministry of Finance, Department of Economic Affairs, Government of India
factsSupported: Quarterly benchmark-linked interest rates on small savings schemes: PPF at 7.1%, SCSS at 8.2%, Sukanya Samriddhi at 8.2%, NSC at 7.7%, and POMIS at 7.4%; sovereign guarantee of principal and accrued interest.

title: Analysis of Profit and Loss of Individual Traders dealing in Equity Futures and Options (F&O) Segment
publishingOrganisation: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
factsSupported: Empirical study confirming 93% of individual retail derivative traders incurred average net losses of ₹2.0 Lakhs each between FY22 and FY24; transaction costs accounted for an additional 28% of net trading losses.
applicablePeriod: Empirical Research Report FY 2022 to FY 2024
